children: Bitcoin's slide to the $55,000 level has been accompanied by a sharp increase in selling by investors willing to realize losses, according to an analysis.
On Nov. 21, on-chain analyst Darkfost wrote on X, formerly Twitter, that "extreme capitulation is occurring in the market as Bitcoin set a new low of $55,122."

Darkfost said the ratio of realized profits to realized losses among Bitcoin investors over the past seven days fell to 0.12. That means the value of realized losses was about 8.3 times greater than the value of realized profits. The reading is the lowest since Bitcoin's latest market peak.
Investors are selling Bitcoin in large volumes despite taking losses, Darkfost said, calling it a sign that substantial fear-driven selling is now underway in the market.

title: Analysis: Bitcoin Selling Pressure Intensifies as Price Falls to $55,000
